requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: animation-ready game character master sprite.
Image 1 is the canonical character and the STRICT identity/style reference. Create ONE new full-body sprite of that exact red-haired Reaver character, at the same slightly top-down three-quarter FRONT angle, facing toward image-left.
Pose change: relaxed rigging pose, torso almost upright, feet modestly apart and both toes pointing toward image-left, knees softly straight, both arms lowered about 20 degrees away from the torso, elbows relaxed. Right hand (image-left) is a closed gloved fist ready to hold a separate sword; left gloved fist visible below the cloak. NO sword in this image. Draw complete recognizable anatomy. Keep the short leg lengths and oversized head of the reference; do not make a tall adult or a tiny chibi.
CRITICAL appearance match: compact wiry adventurer, jagged dark rusty-red spiky hair with the same broken silhouette, one pale amber eye visible above a high brown scarf masking mouth, dark layered worn brown leather armor, diagonal straps, small belt pouches, bulky brown bracers/gloves, worn brown boots, weathered desaturated grey-green tattered short cloak over character's LEFT shoulder (image-right), cloak to below hip. Match the reference's simple costume, proportions and colors extremely closely. No redesign or extra ornaments.
Style: exactly the reference's gritty low-resolution hand-painted PIXEL ART. Dark hard jagged pixel silhouettes; small crisp irregular pixel clusters, ochre highlights, dark sparse surfaces, subdued highlights. NOT smooth illustration, not modern high-res anime, not 3D, no glossy render. Underlying character should read as approximately 150 pixels wide by 230 pixels tall, enlarged using nearest-neighbor pixel edges. Consistent restrained upper-left lighting.
Composition: ONE sprite centered, entire head and both boots in frame, generous transparent padding, no props, no floor, no shadow, no text, no border. Actual transparent RGBA background.
requests.verdict: Rejected: brighter costume, larger facial features, soft glow, changed paint density.

requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a single production sprite-parts atlas for skeletal animation.
Input 1 is the CANONICAL character and strict style, costume and color reference. Input 2 shows enlarged actual pieces cut from that sprite: this is the strict paint reference, not a layout to copy.
Create ONE atlas containing FOUR fully drawn detached appendages from this same character, arranged left-to-right in one row with large empty gutters: (1) complete right arm from rounded shoulder through sleeve/elbow/bracer to closed gloved fist, (2) complete left arm in the same outfit from shoulder to gloved fist, (3) complete right leg from rounded upper thigh through trouser knee and wrapped shin to low brown boot, (4) complete left leg from upper thigh through knee and shin to matching low brown boot.
All four point downward in a relaxed almost-straight pose. View all from the canonical slightly top-down three-quarter FRONT camera. BOTH boot toes point toward image-left (side/three-quarter boot view, NOT pointing at the viewer). Both arms show the warm outer/front surfaces. Draw all hidden portions fully, including complete rounded shoulder and upper-thigh ends, elbow, knee and ankle. Each piece must be contiguous with no holes, crops, or missing sections.
Copy the canonical's ACTUAL restrained gritty dark paint: very dark worn brown cloth/leather, a few muted ochre scuffs and tiny sparse black fastenings, dark broken crisp pixel outlines. The bracers and shin wraps are functional and rough; no new fancy armor plates, rings or metal buckles. Match the scale of existing costume features. Reference 2 has the exact desired colors and small irregular pixel clusters. Aim ~24 pixels wide, 60 pixels tall per arm, ~28 pixels wide, 85 pixels tall per leg at native game size. Present enlarged enough to inspect but retain those simple crisp pixel-art clusters.
Do NOT draw a full character, torso, head, cape, weapon, labels, grid or shadows. Actual TRANSPARENT RGBA background, with no black backdrop, no ambient haze, no glow. Exactly four separated continuous appendages, no duplicates or extra objects.
requests.verdict: Rejected: fake checkerboard (RGB), fine texture and smooth round highlights.

requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: image 1 (the FOUR separate appendages atlas). Supporting input: image 2 is the canonical sprite; image 3 is exact enlarged pixel art cut from that sprite.
Keep the four appendages, their scale, positions, continuous complete anatomy and their relaxed poses. Correct ONLY the rendering and backdrop.
Replace the false checkerboard with a perfectly flat solid bright magenta background (#ff00ff). No texture, no shadows, no glow, no checkerboard, no text. Hard opaque silhouette boundaries so the single flat color can be keyed.
Match the reference sprite's very DARK, rough, sparingly highlighted pixel-art leather and cloth. Use simple broad DARK brown and near-black shapes with small hard ochre pixel chips; eliminate the softly modeled tubes, shiny round shoulder domes and fuzzy dither. The upper arm is a creased leather sleeve, NOT a round metal pauldron. Thighs are dark worn brown trousers, NOT smooth large shiny armor pads. Keep the brown wrap-straps, small closed gloved fists and low boots, no new ornaments. Use the sharp irregular paint clusters and near-black outlines seen in image 3. Do not brighten or increase color saturation. Keep all four separate, front three-quarter view, both low boots pointing image-left.
requests.verdict: Rejected: keyed background usable but surface still too finely noisy; required value grouping correction.

requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target: four isolated limb sprites on magenta. Image 2 is the exact canonical paint reference.
Keep the four silhouettes, anatomy, placement, wrap straps, fists, boot directions and flat magenta backdrop unchanged. Make ONE correction: change the texture pixel density and value grouping to match the canonical image.
The current limbs have too much fine noisy shaded texture. Repaint them as TRUE low-resolution dark pixel art at a virtual grid of 8 output pixels per native pixel (each arm about 24 native pixels wide). Make broad connected near-black shadow shapes, chunky dark brown middle-value shapes, and only a few sparse jagged ochre highlight clusters, exactly like the canonical outfit. No tiny dither, no gradients, no smooth volume, no fuzzy pixel noise. There should be only about 6 brown/black color values in each limb. Highlight edges should be broken angular chips, not a round smooth rim. The canonical deliberately loses much of each limb into almost black shapes.
Do not redesign, add ornaments, change poses, change composition, or add text. Exactly the same FOUR appendages with crisp dark outlined edges on perfectly uniform #ff00ff.
requests.verdict: Accepted after native assembly, all 136 front poses and actual-board travel review: subdued grouped brown/ochre values, complete anatomy, left-directed boots and consistent costume. Slightly slimmer/relaxed silhouette is deliberate.

requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single REAR-view production sprite-parts atlas matching an existing FRONT atlas.
Image 1 is the selected front limb atlas: STRICT costume, proportions, pixel grid, paint style, scale and four-column layout reference. Image 2 is the existing full rear character: direction/occlusion reference only. Image 3 is the canonical front character: identity reference.
Create the REAR three-quarter view of the same FOUR appendages in the same left-to-right order, exact same scale and layout: complete right arm, complete left arm, complete right leg, complete left leg. They belong to the same character as image 1. Draw the back/outside of the sleeves, bracers, gloves, brown trousers, wrapped shins and low boots. Full anatomy shoulder-to-fist and thigh-to-boot, complete round joint ends, continuous pieces.
Match the slightly top-down rear three-quarter camera in image 2. Both boot toes point toward IMAGE-RIGHT and away from viewer: show the back/heel and outer side of the near boot, NOT a front-facing toe cap. The far boot is a shorter foreshortened heel/side view also pointing right. Do not merely mirror the front paint; draw correct rear surfaces. Do not add knee armor onto the back of a knee. One arm is slightly angled right downward and the other slightly left downward, as a relaxed setup.
Style MUST remain the dark chunky low-resolution pixel art of image 1: broad near-black shadows, dark brown midtones, sparse angular muted ochre scuffs, crisp irregular pixel clusters at about 8 output pixels per virtual native pixel. No grain, gradients, smooth highlights, glossy 3D, or new costume ornament.
Exactly FOUR separated appendages on perfectly uniform solid #ff00ff magenta. No full character, head, torso, cloak, sword, text, labels, grid, shadows or extra objects.
requests.verdict: Accepted after native assembly, all 136 rear poses and actual-board travel review: matching subdued costume, complete joints, rear heels and right-directed toes. Rear head/cloak remain the prior reference interpretation.

requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one two-view hidden pelvis sprite atlas for a 2D skeletal game character.
Image 1 is the selected FRONT limb paint style. Image 2 is the matching REAR limb paint. Image 3 is the canonical character whose belt will cover most of this new component.
Create exactly TWO detached PELVIS / UPPER-TROUSER components side by side: left = slightly top-down three-quarter FRONT facing image-left; right = slightly top-down three-quarter REAR facing image-right. They are the same worn dark brown trouser garment as the thighs in the references.
This is the hidden solid anatomy under the character's existing belt, skirt flaps and pouches. Draw a broad continuous waist/hip block with a short upper-thigh stub on each side. The crotch must be fully filled with dark cloth; the thigh stubs attach directly to the hips with no gaps. The top edge is plain and round to overlap the torso; the two bottom leg ends are plain rounded stubs to overlap the separate thighs. The stubs are VERY short; this is just pelvis and hip sockets, no knees, shins or boots.
Approximate native dimensions per component: 60 pixels wide by 36 pixels tall. Preserve the short stocky proportions of the canonical torso. Art is predominantly near-black and very dark muted brown creased cloth, with only a few small angular ochre chips at outer folds. No new belt, buckle, pouches, armor plate, trim, straps, flaps, underwear rim, metal or ornament: those already exist on the overlying art.
EXACT pixel-art style match to images 1/2: broad near-black shadow shapes, sharp irregular dark brown clusters, sparse muted ochre, 8x enlarged native pixel grid; no dithering, fuzzy texture, soft shading, gradients or gloss.
Two isolated complete pieces with generous gutter on perfectly uniform bright #ff00ff magenta. No head, torso, arms, cape, whole character, text, labels, grid or shadow.
requests.verdict: Accepted beneath canonical belt/flaps after full walk/action review: fills newly exposed hip regions without bright or foreign material.

requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one tiny sword-grip component for a pixel-art skeletal sprite.
The reference shows the character's worn chipped sword. Create ONE detached plain sword HANDLE GRIP ONLY, pointing straight up vertically. It will replace the hidden handle pixels beneath a separately animated gloved fist. Do not draw the blade, hand, crossguard or any other object.
Shape: short straight narrow cylindrical grip wrapped in extremely dark worn brown leather, almost black, with a simple dull grey metal end cap at the top and bottom. Native game dimensions approximately 4 pixels wide by 16 pixels tall. Thin straight silhouette, plain functional weapon, sparse single-pixel dark ochre scuffs. No elaborate pommel, jewel, gold, ornament or spikes.
Strict crisp low-resolution pixel-art paint matching the reference's gritty near-black outline, rough dark-brown wraps and restrained grey steel. Show it enlarged with hard pixel blocks, no fine dithering or gradients.
Center the one narrow handle on perfectly uniform #ff00ff magenta with generous empty space. No text, grid, shadow, glow, labels or extra pieces.
requests.verdict: Accepted after full attack/block/walk review: plain dark leather shaft joins the retained guard to the newly painted closed fist. The separate weapon transform avoids folded wrist skin.

final_review.art_match: Preserved canonical identity regions; new complete limbs match costume, dark grouped values and native pixel scale. Neutral silhouette intentionally changes.
